## Type of data problem / 问题类型

- [ ] Unreadable text / contrast issue 文字不可读或对比度不足
- [ ] Broken or malformed HTML markup 标记结构错误
- [ ] Wrong brand tokens (colors, fonts, radii...) 品牌 token 不正确
- [ ] Mislabeled family / state / category / tag 分类或标签错误
- [ ] Duplicate entries 重复条目
- [ ] Rendering artifact in specimen 组件渲染异常
- [ ] Other 其他
